Kentucky Arts Rising

Application Deadline: February 15, 2027 Grant Period: July 1, 2027 - June 30, 2028 Apply Here

About the Program

The Kentucky Arts Rising grant program provides $1,500 for Kentucky-based arts and cultural organizations.

Eligibility

General Requirements

  • be a free-standing arts group independent of any other organization.
  • currently have, and maintain during the grant cycle, IRS tax-exempt status.

Eligible Revenue

Earned revenue from for-profit activity.
